datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select id,
       name,
      to_char(id)||'-'||name as KOD from customers
where id in (select customerid from sbcm_contracts_new)
order by id

datasets.name: Deps
datasets.sql:
select
   cont.id,
   cont.contractno,
   sbcm_stored_programs_new.Get_ContractAccount(Acc.Contractaccid) as ContractAccNO
from sbcm_contracts_new cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts_new acc
where cont.id = acc.id#

datasets.name: ResultData
datasets.sql:
select 
      cont.contractno,
      cont.opendate,
      cont.closedate,
      sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_contractaccount(acc.contractaccid) as ContractAccNo,
      cust.name,sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_contract_BalNo(Cont.ID) as Balans,
      av.val_name , 
      intr.interest as annualint,   
      h1.facticaldebt as frest,
      h1.facticaldebt*o1.ostat as efrest,
      h1.facticalinterestdebt*o1.ostat as finterestrest,
      h1.facticalinterestdebt*o1.ostat as efinterestrest,
      
      nvl(tranche.total,0) as tramt,
      nvl(tranche.etotal,0) as etramt,
      
      nvl(payment.facticaldebt,0) as payamt,
      nvl(payment.efacticaldebt,0) as epayamt,
      nvl(payment.interestdebt,0) as payint,
      nvl(payment.einterestdebt,0) as epayint,
          
      h2.facticaldebt as srest,
      h2.facticaldebt*o2.ostat as esrest,
      h2.facticalinterestdebt*o2.ostat as sinterestrest,
      h2.facticalinterestdebt*o2.ostat as esinterestrest,
      fil.name as filial,
      dt.type  

from sbcm_contracts_new cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts_new acc,
     sbcm_contract_hist_new h1,
     sbcm_contract_hist_new h2,
     sbcm_tranches_temp_new /*report*/ tranche,
     sbcm_payments_temp_new /*report*/ payment,
     sbcm_interests_new intr,
     customers  cust ,
     avalute av,
     operkurs o1,
     operkurs o2,
     filial fil,
     sbcm_deposit_types_new dt
   
where  
  cont.id  = acc.id# and
  cont.customerid = cust.id and
  cont.id = h1.id# and
  cont.id = h2.id# and
  cont.id  = intr.id# and
  cont.currency  = av.valute and
  cont.currency = o1.val_kod and
  cont.currency = o2.val_kod and
  o1.dat = :bdat and  
  o2.dat = :edat and
  h1.hdate = :bdat and  
  h2.hdate = :edat and
  cont.contracttype=dt.id  and
  cont.BRANCHID    =fil.id and
  cont.id = tranche.id# (+) and  
  cont.id = payment.id#(+)
